# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven years old  <sub>[v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001), [v3 c22 P42](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0042)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Robin-boy  <sub>[v3 c22 P23](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0023)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin has short arms compared to older boys and small pink tongue. He has small brown heels. During his youth, he lost a front tooth to a door-and-string extraction.

_Sources: [v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001), [v2 c22 P4](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0004), [v2 c19 P44](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0044), [v3 c22 P18](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0018)_

## Personality

Robin is an energetic, outspoken, and inquisitive boy who frequently asks questions about the world and local rules. He can be defiant, jealous of affection, and prone to childish mischief, but he is quick to feel remorse once corrected. He possesses a dramatic imagination and enjoys playful outdoor activities.

_Sources: [v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001), [v2 c22 P8](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0008), [v2 c19 P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 c19 P36](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0036), [v2 c8 P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056), [v2 c8 P63](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0063), [v3 c22 P26](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0026), [v3 c22 P41](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0041)_

- Inquisitive  <sub>[v2 c22 P8](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0008), [v3 c17 P21](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0021), [v3 c22 P26](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0026)</sub>

- Fishing and outdoor play  <sub>[v3 c22 P26](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0026)</sub>

## Goals

- To secure equal affection and attention from Nell  <sub>[v2 c19 P36](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0036), [v2 c19 P38](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0038)</sub>
- To marry Mabel Fletcher when he reaches adulthood  <sub>[v3 c22 P35](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0035), [v3 c22 P39](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0039)</sub>

## History

Robin arrived at Grey Shutters along with his twin sister Lucy after being taken in by Thirza Abernethy and Nell Harcourt. He started attending school in Brierley and settled into daily household life, though he often disrupted meals and engaged in childish antics such as pulling feathers from roosters or placing a live toad in Thirza's bed. After feeling remorse for his prank, he confessed to Nell so she could safely remove the toad. He experienced jealousy toward Cedric Stanhope, fearing Nell favored Cedric over him, but was comforted when Nell reassured him of her affection. Following the death of his father Richard Farrow, a trust fund was established to secure Robin's and Lucy's upbringing at Grey Shutters. As he grew, Robin engaged in childhood business trades, such as selling his pulled front tooth to Milty Gammon, and proudly declared his childhood betrothal to his classmate Mabel Fletcher.

_Sources: [v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001), [v2 c22 P15](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0015), [v2 c22 P19](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0019), [v2 c22 P20](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0020), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025), [v2 c19 P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 c19 P36](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0036), [v2 c19 P42](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0042), [v2 c8 P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 c8 P62](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0062), [v3 c22 P18](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0018), [v3 c22 P35](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0035), [v3 c22 P39](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0039)_

## Background by volume

- Orphaned twin brother of Lucy Farrow, brought to live at Grey Shutters under the care of Thirza Abernethy and Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v2 c22 P15](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0015), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025)</sub>
- Son of the late Richard Farrow, who left a trust fund for him and Lucy  <sub>[v2 c22 P20](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0020), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)</sub>
